manifest.summary: Hub tile for Eighty Six, the from-scratch Godot 4.7 Juggernaut walker game built in ~/Games/eightysix (a separate repo, not this one). Launches the game or its editor, and shows its test results, per-preset frame rates, check-image galleries and README state without leaving Forge.

features.name: Play / Open in editor
features.description: Play runs the game's own <root>/tools/play.sh, which rebuilds the Linux export first when the source changed, saves each changed build as a numbered version and runs it (falls back to the build, then 'godot --path <root>', when the launcher is missing). Open in Godot editor runs 'godot -e --path <root>'. Both detached, logged to outputs/eightysix-launch.log.

features.name: Versions and share zips
features.description: Lists <root>/build/versions/NNN-*/VERSION.json newest first with a Play button per version (play.sh --version N). 'Make share zips' starts <root>/tools/builds.py share in the background: Windows, Linux and macOS zips of the newest saved version, built from that version's own commit in a scratch checkout, each with an install script (install.bat / install.sh / install.command) and HOW-TO-RUN.txt, into <root>/build/share/; the older zips are deleted once the new ones are made (Emerson, 2026-10-02: keep only the latest). 'Delete all share zips' runs builds.py clear-shares. GET /api/share shows the zips, whether a run is going and the last log line (<root>/logs/share.log).

features.name: Tests
features.description: Shows <root>/logs/tests-last.json (pass/fail counts and per-test results). A Run tests button starts <root>/tools/run_tests.sh in the background and the panel refreshes; if that script does not exist yet it says so instead of failing.

features.name: Frame rates
features.description: Newest <root>/logs/fps/*.json per graphics preset (low, medium, high, ultra) in a table against its target fps; ultra has no target.

features.name: Check images
features.description: Thumbnails from the newest <root>/images/NNN-name/ folder, click to enlarge, with a picker for older folders. Served through an endpoint locked to <root>/images.

features.name: README
features.description: The game's README.md 'Current state' section and its newest dated log entry, shown as plain text.

manifest.data_dir: EIGHTYSIX_ROOT env var, default ~/Games/eightysix (the game's own repo; this app only reads/launches it)
manifest.api_base: /api  (GET /api/status; GET/POST /api/tests; GET /api/fps; GET /api/images, /api/images/{folder}, /api/images/{folder}/{file}; GET /api/readme; GET /api/versions; POST /api/play {version?}, /api/play/editor, /api/share)
known_gaps: Play and editor launches call the real 'godot' binary and are covered by a subprocess-mocked test, not a live game window (headless test sandbox).
Share zips are listed as paths; there is no download or open-folder button yet.
